verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scheduled runs (PR reviews, CI failure analysis, dependency audits), trigger-based workflows (Slack mentions, GitHub PR reviews), and long-running/background tasks, showing genuine support for always-on automation. However, community reports raise real concerns about autonomous reliability—self-verification failures, quality degradation over time, and unpredictable fixes—undercutting confidence in unattended 'maintain and fix' operation.
